tasks.old_behavior: struct commit_list *copy_commit_list(struct commit_list *l) — deprecated inline wrapper that delegated to commit_list_copy(l); struct commit_list *reverse_commit_list(struct commit_list *l) — deprecated inline wrapper that delegated to commit_list_reverse(l); void free_commit_list(struct commit_list *l) — deprecated inline wrapper that delegated to commit_list_free(l). The functions were declared static inline in public header commit.h with a deprecation notice stating removal after Git 2.53.
tasks.new_behavior: The three deprecated inline wrapper functions are removed. Callers must use the long-form names commit_list_copy(), commit_list_reverse(), and commit_list_free() directly, which are still declared in commit.h at lines 199, 202, and 204 respectively.
tasks.compatibility_reason: Any downstream code that includes commit.h and still calls the deprecated one-letter-form wrappers (copy_commit_list, reverse_commit_list, free_commit_list) will fail to compile after this change. The functions were explicitly deprecated with a planned removal timeline and were only provided as compatibility shims for in-flight upstream topics. Internal Git codebase has already been migrated in ancestor commit 7dd898a92 ('*: replace deprecated free_commit_list'), so only external consumers of Git's library headers are affected.
tasks.test_recommendation: Verify that the existing replacement names (commit_list_copy, commit_list_reverse, commit_list_free) are correctly declared and available at the same header location. Run a compile test to ensure no transitive header inclusion breaks.
